      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with different control CC numbers', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with different control MIDI channels', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].midiChannel = 2;
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with different min values', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].minValue = 10;
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with different max values', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].maxValue = 100;
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should ignore name differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode('Mode A');
      const mode2 = createTestMode('Mode B');
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should ignore description differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.description = 'Different description';
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should ignore version differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.version = '2.0.0';
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should ignore createdAt differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.createdAt = '2025-01-02T00:00:00Z';
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should ignore modifiedAt differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.modifiedAt = '2025-01-02T00:00:00Z';
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should ignore label differences', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].label = 'Different Label';
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with different control keys', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      delete mode2.controls['fader-cc5'];
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return false for modes with additional controls', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      mode2.controls['button-cc37'] = {
        id: 'button-cc37',
        type: 'button',
        ccNumber: 37,
        midiChannel: 1,
        minValue: 0,
        maxValue: 127,
      };
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should handle modes with empty controls', () => {
      const mode1 = { ...createTestMode(), controls: {} };
      const mode2 = { ...createTestMode(), controls: {} };
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return false when one mode has empty controls', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = { ...createTestMode(), controls: {} };
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should handle modes with many controls', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();

      // Add multiple controls
      for (let i = 14; i <= 20; i++) {
        const control = {
          id: `knob-cc${i}`,
          type: 'knob' as const,
          ccNumber: i,
          midiChannel: 1,
          minValue: 0,
          maxValue: 127,
        };
        mode1.controls[`knob-cc${i}`] = control;
        mode2.controls[`knob-cc${i}`] = control;
      }

      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should handle controls in different order', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2: CustomMode = {
        ...createTestMode(),
        controls: {
          'fader-cc5': mode1.controls['fader-cc5'],
          'knob-cc13': mode1.controls['knob-cc13'],
        },
      };
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should generate consistent hashes for same data', () => {
      const mode1 = createTestMode();
      const mode2 = createTestMode();
      const mode3 = createTestMode();

      // Call multiple times to ensure consistency
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode2)).toBe(true);
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode2, mode3)).toBe(true);
      expect(modesAreEqual(mode1, mode3)).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('checkSlotSync', () => {
    it('should return true for synced modes', async () => {
      const editBuffer = createTestMode();
      const deviceMode = createLCXL3Mode();

      // Adjust editBuffer to match device mode structure
      editBuffer.name = 'Device Mode';

      const result = await checkSlotSync(editBuffer, deviceMode);
      expect(result).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return false for different modes', async () => {
      const editBuffer = createTestMode();
      const deviceMode = createLCXL3Mode();

      // Change a control
      editBuffer.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;

      const result = await checkSlotSync(editBuffer, deviceMode);
      expect(result).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should handle async operation', async () => {
      const editBuffer = createTestMode();
      const deviceMode = createLCXL3Mode();
      editBuffer.name = 'Device Mode';

      const promise = checkSlotSync(editBuffer, deviceMode);
      expect(promise).toBeInstanceOf(Promise);

      const result = await promise;
      expect(typeof result).toBe('boolean');
    });

    it('should return false when controls differ', async () => {
      const editBuffer = createTestMode();
      const deviceMode = createLCXL3Mode();

      editBuffer.controls['knob-cc13'].midiChannel = 2;

      const result = await checkSlotSync(editBuffer, deviceMode);
      expect(result).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return false when min/max differ', async () => {
      const editBuffer = createTestMode();
      const deviceMode = createLCXL3Mode();

      editBuffer.controls['knob-cc13'].minValue = 10;

      const result = await checkSlotSync(editBuffer, deviceMode);
      expect(result).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('SyncTracker', () => {
    let tracker: SyncTracker;

    beforeEach(() => {
      tracker = new SyncTracker();
    });

    describe('constructor', () => {
      it('should create a new tracker with unknown status', () => {
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });
    });

    describe('markFetched', () => {
      it('should set status to synced after fetch', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should update both device and edit buffer hashes', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        // Marking with same mode should remain synced
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle multiple fetches', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode('Mode 1');
        const mode2 = createTestMode('Mode 2');

        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        tracker.markFetched(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });

    describe('markSent', () => {
      it('should set status to synced after send', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markSent(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle multiple sends', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode('Mode 1');
        const mode2 = createTestMode('Mode 2');

        tracker.markSent(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        tracker.markSent(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });

    describe('markEdited', () => {
      it('should set status to modified after edit', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');
      });

      it('should handle edit without prior fetch', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markEdited(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });

      it('should detect when edit returns to synced state', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        // Edit back to original
        tracker.markEdited(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });

    describe('getOptimisticStatus', () => {
      it('should return unknown when no operations', () => {
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });

      it('should return synced after fetch', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should return synced after send', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markSent(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should return modified after edit', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');
      });

      it('should return unknown if only edit buffer is set', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markEdited(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });
    });

    describe('reset', () => {
      it('should reset to unknown status', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        tracker.reset();
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });

      it('should clear all tracked state', () => {
        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        tracker.markEdited(mode);

        tracker.reset();
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });

      it('should allow fresh start after reset', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        tracker.reset();

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });

    describe('integration scenarios', () => {
      it('should handle fetch -> edit -> send workflow', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        tracker.markSent(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle fetch -> edit -> fetch (discard changes)', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        // Fetch original again
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle multiple edits', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        const mode3 = createTestMode();
        mode3.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 15;
        tracker.markEdited(mode3);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');
      });

      it('should handle slot switching workflow', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode('Slot 0');
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        // Switch slots
        tracker.reset();
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');

        const mode2 = createTestMode('Slot 1');
        tracker.markFetched(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });
  });
});

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

        tracker.markEdited(mode2);

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markEdited(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });

      it('should detect when edit returns to synced state', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');

        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        tracker.markSent(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should return modified after edit', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');
      });

      it('should return unknown if only edit buffer is set', () => {

        tracker.markEdited(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');
      });
    });

    describe('reset', () => {

        const mode = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        tracker.reset();

        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

    describe('integration scenarios', () => {

        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        tracker.markSent(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle fetch -> edit -> fetch (discard changes)', () => {

        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        // Fetch original again
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });

      it('should handle multiple edits', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode();
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);

        const mode2 = createTestMode();
        mode2.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 14;
        tracker.markEdited(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');

        const mode3 = createTestMode();
        mode3.controls['knob-cc13'].ccNumber = 15;
        tracker.markEdited(mode3);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('modified');
      });

      it('should handle slot switching workflow', () => {
        const mode1 = createTestMode('Slot 0');
        tracker.markFetched(mode1);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');

        // Switch slots
        tracker.reset();
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('unknown');

        const mode2 = createTestMode('Slot 1');
        tracker.markFetched(mode2);
        expect(tracker.getOptimisticStatus()).toBe('synced');
      });
    });
  });
});

_**User (sidechain)**_

Implement comprehensive tests for custom React hooks using **Vitest** and **@testing-library/react**.

## Your Mission

Create test suites for the custom hooks in the project.

**Target**: 85%+ coverage for each hook

## Hook Testing Pattern with Vitest

```typescript
import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useYourHook } from '@/hooks/useYourHook';

describe('useYourHook', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('should initialize with default values', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useYourHook());
    
    expect(result.current.someValue).toBe(expectedDefault);
  });

  it('should update state correctly', async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useYourHook());
    
    // Trigger state change
    result.current.updateFunction(newValue);
    
    // Wait for state update
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(result.current.someValue).toBe(newValue);
    });
  });

  it('should cleanup on unmount', () => {
    const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useYourHook());
    
    unmount();
    
    // Verify cleanup occurred
    expect(cleanupSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

## Critical Requirements

1. **Use renderHook** from @testing-library/react
2. **Use waitFor** for async state updates
3. **Mock dependencies** using vi.mock() or dependency injection
4. **Test cleanup** - verify useEffect cleanup functions
5. **Test all state transitions** - initial → loading → success/error
6. **Test error paths** - network errors, validation errors, etc.

## Priority Order

Start with simpler hooks first:

1. **use-mobile.tsx** - Simple window size hook
2. **use-toast.ts** - Toast notification hook
3. **useLocalStorage.ts** - localStorage wrapper hook
4. **useModeBuilder.ts** - Mode building logic
5. **useUserProfile.ts** - User profile management
6. **useCloudModes.ts** - Cloud sync (may be complex)
7. **useLCXL3Device.ts** - Device communication (may need mocking)

## For Hooks with External Dependencies

Mock APIs and external services:

```typescript
// Mock API calls
vi.mock('@/lib/api-client', () => ({
  apiClient: {
    fetchModes: vi.fn(),
    saveMode: vi.fn(),
  }
}));

// Or use dependency injection
const mockApi = {
  fetchModes: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
};

const { result } = renderHook(() => useYourHook(mockApi));
```

## Success Criteria Per Hook

- ✅ Test file created at `src/hooks/__tests__/[hookName].test.ts`
- ✅ All hook return values tested
- ✅ All state transitions tested
- ✅ Cleanup functions verified
- ✅ Error handling covered
- ✅ 85%+ coverage achieved
- ✅ All tests passing

## What to Return

For each hook:
1. **File created**: Path and line count
2. **Tests written**: Number of test cases
3. **Coverage**: Percentage for each metric
4. **Test results**: Pass/fail status
5. **Key scenarios tested**: List main test categories

Start with use-mobile.tsx as it's likely the simplest. Work through the hooks systematically and report progress after each one.

1→import * as React from "react";
     2→
     3→const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;
     4→
     5→export function useIsMobile() {
     6→  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);
     7→
     8→  React.useEffect(() => {
     9→    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    10→    const onChange = () => {
    11→      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    12→    };
    13→    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    14→    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    15→    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    16→  }, []);
    17→
    18→  return !!isMobile;
    19→}
    20→

1→import * as React from "react";
     2→
     3→import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";
     4→
     5→const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
     6→const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;
     7→
     8→type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
     9→  id: string;
    10→  title?: React.ReactNode;
    11→  description?: React.ReactNode;
    12→  action?: ToastActionElement;
    13→};
    14→
    15→const actionTypes = {
    16→  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
    17→  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
    18→  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
    19→  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
    20→} as const;
    21→
    22→let count = 0;
    23→
    24→function genId() {
    25→  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    26→  return count.toString();
    27→}
    28→
    29→type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;
    30→
    31→type Action =
    32→  | {
    33→      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
    34→      toast: ToasterToast;
    35→    }
    36→  | {
    37→      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
    38→      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
    39→    }
    40→  | {
    41→      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
    42→      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    43→    }
    44→  | {
    45→      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
    46→      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    47→    };
    48→
    49→interface State {
    50→  toasts: ToasterToast[];
    51→}
    52→
    53→const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
    54→
    55→const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
    56→  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    57→    return;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    61→    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    62→    dispatch({
    63→      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
    64→      toastId: toastId,
    65→    });
    66→  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);
    67→
    68→  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
    69→};
    70→
    71→export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
    72→  switch (action.type) {
    73→    case "ADD_TOAST":
    74→      return {
    75→        ...state,
    76→        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
    77→      };
    78→
    79→    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
    80→      return {
    81→        ...state,
    82→        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) => (t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t)),
    83→      };
    84→
    85→    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
    86→      const { toastId } = action;
    87→
    88→      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
    89→      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
    90→      if (toastId) {
    91→        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
    92→      } else {
    93→        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
    94→          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
    95→        });
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      return {
    99→        ...state,
   100→        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
   101→          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
   102→            ? {
   103→                ...t,
   104→                open: false,
   105→              }
   106→            : t,
   107→        ),
   108→      };
   109→    }
   110→    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
   111→      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
   112→        return {
   113→          ...state,
   114→          toasts: [],
   115→        };
   116→      }
   117→      return {
   118→        ...state,
   119→        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
   120→      };
   121→  }
   122→};
   123→
   124→const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];
   125→
   126→let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };
   127→
   128→function dispatch(action: Action) {
   129→  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
   130→  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
   131→    listener(memoryState);
   132→  });
   133→}
   134→
   135→type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">;
   136→
   137→function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
   138→  const id = genId();
   139→
   140→  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
   141→    dispatch({
   142→      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
   143→      toast: { ...props, id },
   144→    });
   145→  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });
   146→
   147→  dispatch({
   148→    type: "ADD_TOAST",
   149→    toast: {
   150→      ...props,
   151→      id,
   152→      open: true,
   153→      onOpenChange: (open) => {
   154→        if (!open) dismiss();
   155→      },
   156→    },
   157→  });
   158→
   159→  return {
   160→    id: id,
   161→    dismiss,
   162→    update,
   163→  };
   164→}
   165→
   166→function useToast() {
   167→  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);
   168→
   169→  React.useEffect(() => {
   170→    listeners.push(setState);
   171→    return () => {
   172→      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
   173→      if (index > -1) {
   174→        listeners.splice(index, 1);
   175→      }
   176→    };
   177→  }, [state]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    ...state,
   181→    toast,
   182→    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
   183→  };
   184→}
   185→
   186→export { useToast, toast };
   187→

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';
     3→import { LocalStorageManager } from '@/lib/storage/local-storage';
     4→
     5→const AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2000;
     6→
     7→interface UseLocalStorageOptions {
     8→  autoSave: boolean;
     9→  onLoadSuccess?: (mode: CustomMode) => void;
    10→  onLoadError?: (error: Error) => void;
    11→  onSaveSuccess?: () => void;
    12→  onSaveError?: (error: Error) => void;
    13→}
    14→
    15→export function useLocalStorage(
    16→  mode: CustomMode,
    17→  isDirty: boolean,
    18→  options: UseLocalStorageOptions
    19→) {
    20→  const storageManager = useRef(new LocalStorageManager());
    21→  const saveTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
    22→  const lastSavedRef = useRef<string>('');
    23→
    24→  const saveToStorage = useCallback(() => {
    25→    try {
    26→      const modeJson = JSON.stringify(mode);
    27→
    28→      if (modeJson === lastSavedRef.current) {
    29→        return;
    30→      }
    31→
    32→      storageManager.current.save(mode);
    33→      lastSavedRef.current = modeJson;
    34→      options.onSaveSuccess?.();
    35→    } catch (error) {
    36→      options.onSaveError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Failed to save'));
    37→    }
    38→  }, [mode, options]);
    39→
    40→  const loadFromStorage = useCallback(() => {
    41→    try {
    42→      const loaded = storageManager.current.load();
    43→      if (loaded) {
    44→        lastSavedRef.current = JSON.stringify(loaded);
    45→        options.onLoadSuccess?.(loaded);
    46→      }
    47→    } catch (error) {
    48→      options.onLoadError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Failed to load'));
    49→    }
    50→  }, [options]);
    51→
    52→  const clearStorage = useCallback(() => {
    53→    storageManager.current.clear();
    54→    lastSavedRef.current = '';
    55→  }, []);
    56→
    57→  const getSavedAt = useCallback(() => {
    58→    return storageManager.current.getSavedAt();
    59→  }, []);
    60→
    61→  const getStorageSize = useCallback(() => {
    62→    return storageManager.current.getStorageSize();
    63→  }, []);
    64→
    65→  useEffect(() => {
    66→    loadFromStorage();
    67→  }, [loadFromStorage]);
    68→
    69→  useEffect(() => {
    70→    if (!options.autoSave || !isDirty) {
    71→      return;
    72→    }
    73→
    74→    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
    75→      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    79→      saveToStorage();
    80→    }, AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    81→
    82→    return () => {
    83→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
    84→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
    85→      }
    86→    };
    87→  }, [mode, isDirty, options.autoSave, saveToStorage]);
    88→
    89→  return {
    90→    saveToStorage,
    91→    loadFromStorage,
    92→    clearStorage,
    93→    getSavedAt,
    94→    getStorageSize,
    95→  };
    96→}

1→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { CustomMode, ControlMapping } from '@/types/mode';
     3→import { Control } from '@/types/controls';
     4→
     5→interface UseModeBuilderOptions {
     6→  initialMode?: CustomMode;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export function useModeBuilder(options?: UseModeBuilderOptions) {
    10→  const [mode, setMode] = useState<CustomMode>(options?.initialMode || {
    11→    name: 'Untitled Mode',
    12→    description: '',
    13→    controls: {},
    14→  });
    15→
    16→  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
    17→
    18→  const loadMode = useCallback((newMode: CustomMode) => {
    19→    setMode(newMode);
    20→    setIsDirty(false);
    21→  }, []);
    22→
    23→  const mapControlIdToMode = (control: Control): string => {
    24→    if (control.type === 'knob') {
    25→      const match = control.id.match(/knob-(\d+)-(\d+)/);
    26→      if (match) {
    27→        const row = parseInt(match[1]);
    28→        const col = parseInt(match[2]);
    29→        const knobLabels = [
    30→          ['SEND_A1', 'SEND_A2', 'SEND_A3', 'SEND_A4', 'SEND_A5', 'SEND_A6', 'SEND_A7', 'SEND_A8'],
    31→          ['SEND_B1', 'SEND_B2', 'SEND_B3', 'SEND_B4', 'SEND_B5', 'SEND_B6', 'SEND_B7', 'SEND_B8'],
    32→          ['PAN1', 'PAN2', 'PAN3', 'PAN4', 'PAN5', 'PAN6', 'PAN7', 'PAN8'],
    33→        ];
    34→        return knobLabels[row - 1]?.[col - 1] || control.id;
    35→      }
    36→    } else if (control.type === 'fader') {
    37→      const match = control.id.match(/fader-(\d+)/);
    38→      if (match) {
    39→        return `FADER${match[1]}`;
    40→      }
    41→    } else if (control.type === 'button') {
    42→      const match = control.id.match(/fader-btn-(\d+)/);
    43→      if (match) {
    44→        return `FOCUS${match[1]}`;
    45→      }
    46→    }
    47→    return control.id;
    48→  };
    49→
    50→  const updateControl = useCallback((control: Control, updates: Partial<ControlMapping>) => {
    51→    const controlKey = mapControlIdToMode(control);
    52→
    53→    setMode((prev) => {
    54→      const existing = prev.controls[controlKey] || {
    55→        type: control.type,
    56→        channel: control.channel,
    57→        cc: control.ccNumber,
    58→        min: 0,
    59→        max: 127,
    60→        behaviour: 'absolute' as const,
    61→      };
    62→
    63→      return {
    64→        ...prev,
    65→        controls: {
    66→          ...prev.controls,
    67→          [controlKey]: {
    68→            ...existing,
    69→            ...updates,
    70→          },
    71→        },
    72→      };
    73→    });
    74→
    75→    setIsDirty(true);
    76→  }, []);
    77→
    78→  const getControlMapping = useCallback((control: Control): ControlMapping | null => {
    79→    const controlKey = mapControlIdToMode(control);
    80→    return mode.controls[controlKey] || null;
    81→  }, [mode]);
    82→
    83→  const updateModeName = useCallback((name: string) => {
    84→    setMode((prev) => ({ ...prev, name }));
    85→    setIsDirty(true);
    86→  }, []);
    87→
    88→  const updateModeDescription = useCallback((description: string) => {
    89→    setMode((prev) => ({ ...prev, description }));
    90→    setIsDirty(true);
    91→  }, []);
    92→
    93→  const resetMode = useCallback(() => {
    94→    setMode({
    95→      name: 'Untitled Mode',
    96→      description: '',
    97→      controls: {},
    98→    });
    99→    setIsDirty(false);
   100→  }, []);
   101→
   102→  const exportMode = useCallback(() => {
   103→    return JSON.stringify(mode, null, 2);
   104→  }, [mode]);
   105→
   106→  const importMode = useCallback((json: string) => {
   107→    try {
   108→      const imported = JSON.parse(json);
   109→      if (imported.name && typeof imported.controls === 'object') {
   110→        setMode(imported);
   111→        setIsDirty(true);
   112→        return true;
   113→      }
   114→      return false;
   115→    } catch {
   116→      return false;
   117→    }
   118→  }, []);
   119→
   120→  const markClean = useCallback(() => {
   121→    setIsDirty(false);
   122→  }, []);
   123→
   124→  return {
   125→    mode,
   126→    isDirty,
   127→    updateControl,
   128→    getControlMapping,
   129→    updateModeName,
   130→    updateModeDescription,
   131→    resetMode,
   132→    exportMode,
   133→    importMode,
   134→    loadMode,
   135→    markClean,
   136→  };
   137→}

import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useIsMobile } from '@/hooks/use-mobile';

describe('useIsMobile', () => {
  let matchMediaMock: {
    matches: boolean;
    addEventListener: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    removeEventListener: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    // Create a mock matchMedia object
    matchMediaMock = {
      matches: false,
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
    };

    // Mock window.matchMedia
    vi.stubGlobal('matchMedia', vi.fn((query: string) => matchMediaMock));
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('should initialize with undefined and return false', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should return true when window width is below mobile breakpoint (768px)', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 500,
    });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
  });

  it('should return false when window width is at or above mobile breakpoint', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 768,
    });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should return false when window width is exactly at breakpoint - 1', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 767,
    });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
  });

  it('should add event listener to matchMedia on mount', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });

    renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(window.matchMedia).toHaveBeenCalledWith('(max-width: 767px)');
    expect(matchMediaMock.addEventListener).toHaveBeenCalledWith('change', expect.any(Function));
  });

  it('should remove event listener on unmount', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });

    const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    unmount();

    expect(matchMediaMock.removeEventListener).toHaveBeenCalledWith('change', expect.any(Function));
  });

  it('should update isMobile when window is resized', async () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });

    const { result, rerender } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(false);

    // Simulate window resize
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 500,
    });

    // Get the change listener that was registered
    const changeListener = matchMediaMock.addEventListener.mock.calls[0][1];

    // Call the listener to simulate media query change
    changeListener();

    // Force re-render to get updated state
    rerender();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(result.current).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  it('should handle multiple resize events correctly', async () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });

    const { result, rerender } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    expect(result.current).toBe(false);

    // Get the change listener
    const changeListener = matchMediaMock.addEventListener.mock.calls[0][1];

    // First resize to mobile
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 500,
    });
    changeListener();
    rerender();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(result.current).toBe(true);
    });

    // Second resize back to desktop
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 1024,
    });
    changeListener();
    rerender();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(result.current).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  it('should handle edge case at exact breakpoint boundary', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', {
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      value: 768,
    });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());

    // 768 should NOT be mobile (breakpoint is < 768)
    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useToast, toast, reducer } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

describe('useToast', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllTimers();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  describe('reducer', () => {
    it('should add a toast to empty state', () => {
      const initialState = { toasts: [] };
      const toast = {
        id: '1',
        title: 'Test Toast',
        description: 'Test description',
        open: true,
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'ADD_TOAST',
        toast,
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0]).toEqual(toast);
    });

    it('should limit toasts to TOAST_LIMIT (1)', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
        ],
      };
      const newToast = {
        id: '2',
        title: 'Toast 2',
        open: true,
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'ADD_TOAST',
        toast: newToast,
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0].id).toBe('2');
    });

    it('should update existing toast', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Original', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Other', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
        toast: { id: '1', title: 'Updated' },
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].title).toBe('Updated');
      expect(newState.toasts[1].title).toBe('Other');
    });

    it('should not update non-existent toast', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Original', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
        toast: { id: '999', title: 'Should not exist' },
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].title).toBe('Original');
    });

    it('should dismiss specific toast by id', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
        toastId: '1',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].open).toBe(false);
      expect(newState.toasts[1].open).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should dismiss all toasts when no toastId provided', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].open).toBe(false);
      expect(newState.toasts[1].open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should remove specific toast by id', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
        toastId: '1',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0].id).toBe('2');
    });

    it('should remove all toasts when no toastId provided', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('toast function', () => {
    it('should create a toast with title and description', () => {
      const result = toast({
        title: 'Test Title',
        description: 'Test Description',
      });

      expect(result.id).toBeDefined();
      expect(result.dismiss).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
      expect(result.update).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
    });

    it('should return unique ids for multiple toasts', () => {
      const toast1 = toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
      const toast2 = toast({ title: 'Toast 2' });

      expect(toast1.id).not.toBe(toast2.id);
    });

    it('should allow updating toast via returned update function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Original',
        });

        toastInstance.update({
          id: toastInstance.id,
          title: 'Updated',
        });
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.title).toBe('Updated');
    });

    it('should allow dismissing toast via returned dismiss function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test',
        });

        toastInstance.dismiss();
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('useToast hook', () => {
    it('should initialize with empty toasts', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      expect(result.current.toasts).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('should add toast when toast function is called', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
          description: 'Test Description',
        });
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Test Toast');
    });

    it('should expose dismiss function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      expect(result.current.dismiss).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
    });

    it('should dismiss specific toast by id', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should dismiss all toasts when no id provided', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
        result.current.toast({ title: 'Toast 2' });
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss();
      });

      // Due to TOAST_LIMIT of 1, only one toast exists
      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should cleanup listener on unmount', () => {
      const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      unmount();

      // If this doesn't throw, cleanup worked
      expect(true).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should handle multiple hook instances with shared state', () => {
      const { result: result1 } = renderHook(() => useToast());
      const { result: result2 } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result1.current.toast({ title: 'Shared Toast' });
      });

      // Both instances should see the same toast
      expect(result1.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result2.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result1.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Shared Toast');
      expect(result2.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Shared Toast');
    });

    it('should call onOpenChange when toast is dismissed', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      // Get the onOpenChange callback
      const onOpenChange = result.current.toasts[0]?.onOpenChange;
      expect(onOpenChange).toBeInstanceOf(Function);

      act(() => {
        onOpenChange?.(false);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should schedule toast removal after dismiss', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);

      // Fast-forward time to trigger removal
      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000000);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('should not duplicate removal timeout', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      // Dismiss twice
      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      // Fast-forward time
      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000000);
      });

      // Should still only have removed once
      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('edge cases', () => {
    it('should handle empty title and description', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({});
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('should generate incrementing ids', () => {
      const toast1 = toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
      const toast2 = toast({ title: 'Toast 2' });
      const toast3 = toast({ title: 'Toast 3' });

      expect(parseInt(toast2.id)).toBeGreaterThan(parseInt(toast1.id));
      expect(parseInt(toast3.id)).toBeGreaterThan(parseInt(toast2.id));
    });

    it('should handle id counter wrapping at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER', () => {
      // This tests that the modulo operation works
      const result1 = toast({ title: 'Test' });
      expect(result1.id).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});

import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useToast, toast, reducer } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

describe('useToast', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    // Clean up all toasts after each test
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());
    act(() => {
      result.current.dismiss();
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000000);
    });

    vi.clearAllTimers();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  describe('reducer', () => {
    it('should add a toast to empty state', () => {
      const initialState = { toasts: [] };
      const toastItem = {
        id: '1',
        title: 'Test Toast',
        description: 'Test description',
        open: true,
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'ADD_TOAST',
        toast: toastItem,
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0]).toEqual(toastItem);
    });

    it('should limit toasts to TOAST_LIMIT (1)', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
        ],
      };
      const newToast = {
        id: '2',
        title: 'Toast 2',
        open: true,
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'ADD_TOAST',
        toast: newToast,
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0].id).toBe('2');
    });

    it('should update existing toast', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Original', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Other', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
        toast: { id: '1', title: 'Updated' },
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].title).toBe('Updated');
      expect(newState.toasts[1].title).toBe('Other');
    });

    it('should not update non-existent toast', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Original', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
        toast: { id: '999', title: 'Should not exist' },
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].title).toBe('Original');
    });

    it('should dismiss specific toast by id', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
        toastId: '1',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].open).toBe(false);
      expect(newState.toasts[1].open).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should dismiss all toasts when no toastId provided', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts[0].open).toBe(false);
      expect(newState.toasts[1].open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should remove specific toast by id', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
        toastId: '1',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(newState.toasts[0].id).toBe('2');
    });

    it('should remove all toasts when no toastId provided', () => {
      const initialState = {
        toasts: [
          { id: '1', title: 'Toast 1', open: true },
          { id: '2', title: 'Toast 2', open: true },
        ],
      };

      const newState = reducer(initialState, {
        type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
      });

      expect(newState.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('toast function', () => {
    it('should create a toast with title and description', () => {
      const result = toast({
        title: 'Test Title',
        description: 'Test Description',
      });

      expect(result.id).toBeDefined();
      expect(result.dismiss).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
      expect(result.update).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
    });

    it('should return unique ids for multiple toasts', () => {
      const toast1 = toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
      const toast2 = toast({ title: 'Toast 2' });

      expect(toast1.id).not.toBe(toast2.id);
    });

    it('should allow updating toast via returned update function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Original',
        });

        toastInstance.update({
          id: toastInstance.id,
          title: 'Updated',
        });
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.title).toBe('Updated');
    });

    it('should allow dismissing toast via returned dismiss function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test',
        });

        toastInstance.dismiss();
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('useToast hook', () => {
    it('should start without previous toasts', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      // May have toasts from shared state, just verify structure
      expect(Array.isArray(result.current.toasts)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should add toast when toast function is called', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      const initialLength = result.current.toasts.length;

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
          description: 'Test Description',
        });
      });

      // Should have one more toast (TOAST_LIMIT is 1, so it replaces)
      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Test Toast');
    });

    it('should expose dismiss function', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      expect(result.current.dismiss).toBeInstanceOf(Function);
    });

    it('should dismiss specific toast by id', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should dismiss all toasts when no id provided', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss();
      });

      // Due to TOAST_LIMIT of 1, only one toast exists
      if (result.current.toasts.length > 0) {
        expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    it('should cleanup listener on unmount', () => {
      const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      unmount();

      // If this doesn't throw, cleanup worked
      expect(true).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should handle multiple hook instances with shared state', () => {
      const { result: result1 } = renderHook(() => useToast());
      const { result: result2 } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result1.current.toast({ title: 'Shared Toast' });
      });

      // Both instances should see the same toast
      expect(result1.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result2.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result1.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Shared Toast');
      expect(result2.current.toasts[0].title).toBe('Shared Toast');
    });

    it('should call onOpenChange when toast is dismissed', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
      });

      // Get the onOpenChange callback
      const onOpenChange = result.current.toasts[0]?.onOpenChange;
      expect(onOpenChange).toBeInstanceOf(Function);

      act(() => {
        onOpenChange?.(false);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts[0]?.open).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should schedule toast removal after dismiss', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);

      // Fast-forward time to trigger removal
      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000000);
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('should not duplicate removal timeout', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      let toastId: string;
      act(() => {
        const toastInstance = result.current.toast({
          title: 'Test Toast',
        });
        toastId = toastInstance.id;
      });

      // Dismiss twice
      act(() => {
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
        result.current.dismiss(toastId);
      });

      // Fast-forward time
      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000000);
      });

      // Should still only have removed once
      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('edge cases', () => {
    it('should handle empty title and description', () => {
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useToast());

      act(() => {
        result.current.toast({});
      });

      expect(result.current.toasts).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('should generate incrementing ids', () => {
      const toast1 = toast({ title: 'Toast 1' });
      const toast2 = toast({ title: 'Toast 2' });
      const toast3 = toast({ title: 'Toast 3' });

      expect(parseInt(toast2.id)).toBeGreaterThan(parseInt(toast1.id));
      expect(parseInt(toast3.id)).toBeGreaterThan(parseInt(toast2.id));
    });

    it('should handle id counter wrapping at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER', () => {
      // This tests that the modulo operation works
      const result1 = toast({ title: 'Test' });
      expect(result1.id).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});

import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useLocalStorage } from '@/hooks/useLocalStorage';
import { CustomMode } from '@/types/mode';

// Create mock functions
const mockSave = vi.fn();
const mockLoad = vi.fn();
const mockClear = vi.fn();
const mockGetSavedAt = vi.fn();
const mockGetStorageSize = vi.fn();

// Mock the LocalStorageManager module
vi.mock('@/lib/storage/local-storage', () => ({
  LocalStorageManager: vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({
    save: mockSave,
    load: mockLoad,
    clear: mockClear,
    getSavedAt: mockGetSavedAt,
    getStorageSize: mockGetStorageSize,
  })),
}));

describe('useLocalStorage', () => {

    mockClear.mockClear();
    mockGetSavedAt.mockClear();
    mockGetStorageSize.mockClear();

    mockMode = {
      name: 'Test Mode',
      description: 'Test Description',
      version: '1.0.0',
      controls: {},
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      modifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllTimers();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  describe('initialization', () => {
    it('should load from storage on mount', () => {
      const onLoadSuccess = vi.fn();
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onLoadSuccess,
        })
      );

      expect(mockLoad).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('should call onLoadSuccess when data is loaded', () => {
      const onLoadSuccess = vi.fn();
      const savedMode: CustomMode = {
        ...mockMode,
        name: 'Saved Mode',
      };
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(savedMode);

      renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onLoadSuccess,
        })
      );

      expect(onLoadSuccess).toHaveBeenCalledWith(savedMode);
    });

    it('should call onLoadError when loading fails', () => {
      const onLoadError = vi.fn();
      const error = new Error('Load failed');
      mockLoad.mockImplementation(() => {
        throw error;
      });

      renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onLoadError,
        })
      );

      expect(onLoadError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(error);
    });

    it('should not call onLoadSuccess if storage returns null', () => {
      const onLoadSuccess = vi.fn();
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onLoadSuccess,
        })
      );

      expect(onLoadSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('manual save', () => {
    it('should save mode when saveToStorage is called', () => {
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      const { result } = renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
        })
      );

      act(() => {
        result.current.saveToStorage();
      });

      expect(mockSave).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockMode);
    });

    it('should call onSaveSuccess when save succeeds', () => {
      const onSaveSuccess = vi.fn();
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);
      mockSave.mockReturnValue(true);

      const { result } = renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onSaveSuccess,
        })
      );

      act(() => {
        result.current.saveToStorage();
      });

      expect(onSaveSuccess).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('should call onSaveError when save fails', () => {
      const onSaveError = vi.fn();
      const error = new Error('Save failed');
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);
      mockSave.mockImplementation(() => {
        throw error;
      });

      const { result } = renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
          onSaveError,
        })
      );

      act(() => {
        result.current.saveToStorage();
      });

      expect(onSaveError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(error);
    });

    it('should not save if mode has not changed (same JSON)', () => {

      );

      // Should not save again
      expect(mockSave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

      renderHook(() =>

        })
      );

      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(3000);
      });

      expect(mockSave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should cleanup timeout on unmount', () => {
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      const { unmount } = renderHook(() =>

          autoSave: true,
        })
      );

      unmount();

      act(() => {
        vi.advanceTimersByTime(3000);
      });

      // Should not save after unmount
      expect(mockSave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('clear storage', () => {
    it('should clear storage when clearStorage is called', () => {
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      const { result } = renderHook(() =>

          autoSave: false,
        })
      );

      act(() => {
        result.current.clearStorage();
      });

      expect(mockClear).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('should reset last saved ref after clearing', () => {
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);

      const { result } = renderHook(() =>
        useLocalStorage(mockMode, false, {
          autoSave: false,
        })
      );

      // Save first
      act(() => {
        result.current.saveToStorage();
      });

      expect(mockSave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

      // Clear
      act(() => {
        result.current.clearStorage();
      });

      // Save again with same mode
      act(() => {
        result.current.saveToStorage();
      });

      // Should save again since ref was cleared
      expect(mockSave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });
  });

  describe('getSavedAt', () => {
    it('should return saved timestamp', () => {
      const savedDate = new Date('2023-01-01');
      mockLoad.mockReturnValue(null);
